stem: In triangle \(ABC\), point \(D\) lies on \(\overline{AC}\) so that \(AB = BD = DC\). The measure of angle \(ACB\) is \(34^{\circ}\). What is the measure, in degrees, of angle \(ABC\)?
solution: \(BD = DC\), so triangle \(BDC\) is isosceles: angle \(DBC\) = angle \(DCB = 34^{\circ}\).
Angle \(BDA\) is an exterior angle of triangle \(BDC\): \(34 + 34 = 68^{\circ}\).
\(AB = BD\), so angle \(BAD\) = angle \(BDA = 68^{\circ}\), and angle \(ABD = 180 - 136 = 44^{\circ}\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. This is angle \(ABD\) only; angle \(DBC\) (34°) must be added to it.
explanation.B: Correct. Angle \(DBC = 34^{\circ}\) and angle \(ABD = 44^{\circ}\), so angle \(ABC = 78^{\circ}\).
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the measure of angle \(BAC\) (and of angle \(BDA\)), not angle \(ABC\).
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is angle \(BDC\), the vertex angle of triangle \(BDC\), not angle \(ABC\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'A': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'D': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'A', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'D'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('A','B')-d('B','D'))<0.01 and abs(d('B','D')-d('D','C'))<0.01 and abs(ang('A','D','C')-180)<0.1
assert abs(ang('A','C','B')-34)<0.1
adb=2*34
ans=(180-2*adb)+34
assert ans==78 and abs(ang('A','B','C')-ans)<0.1
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
